flag: I_ANNVAL-type (ERN_VAL, WS_VAL, SE_VAL, FRM_VAL, DIV_VAL, RNT_VAL, PAW_VAL, WC_VAL, ...)
dictionary_text: "Levels 1-3 indicate imputations use of income range responses and 4-8 indicate imputations without range responses. Within each group, lower numbers indicate more match variables (and better matches)." 7 = "Level 104 statistical match (age, sex)"; 8 = "Level 105 statistical match (all donors can match to all recipients)"; 9 = "FL_665 ≠ 1 (full record impute)".

flag: Composite value flags (I_INTVAL, I_UCVAL, I_SSVAL, I_SSIVAL, I_VETVAL)
dictionary_text: "Imputation for non-response was conducted on the component variables." 11-14 = value imputed is <25%, 25-50%, 50-75%, 75-100% of the composite; 15 = "Value is 100% imputed in composite variable".

flag: Composite recipiency flags (I_INTYN, I_UCYN, I_SSYN, I_SSIYN, I_DSTYNCOMP)
dictionary_text: 10 = "Some of the components are imputed"; 11 = "All of the components imputed".

"Supplement Interview Status": 0 = "Complete nonresponse to supplement", 1 = "Supplement interview", 2 = "Some supplement response but not enough for interview", 3 = "Supplement interview but not enough income data".

flag: Household flags (I_HFOODS, I_HFDVAL, I_HPUBLI, I_HLOREN, I_HFLUNC, I_HENGAS, I_HENGVA)
dictionary_text: 0 = "No allocation", 1 = "Allocated" (I_HFDVAL, I_HENGVA also 2 = "Allocated with range response").
"Allocation flag for WICYN": 0 = "Not allocated or NIU", 1 = "Allocated".
00 = "Not allocated"; 10-13 edited to a value; 20-23 longitudinal value; 40-43 allocated value.
